title: SvgStop
responsibility: Renders the native stop element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgStop.attributes
inputs.description: Native stop attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgStop.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native stop element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgStop
outputs.description: The actual native stop element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
